paragraphs.text: Ofelia Valenzuela Escandón participated in Shipment VER-11-04 on 2011-11-04. Pacto del Faro Gris was linked to Shipment VER-11-04 on 2011-11-04. Shipment VER-11-04 occurred at Veracruz on 2011-11-04. Liaison reporting from a contact in Chihuahua with access to aviation records described a flight by the light aircraft the Gulf crews call Avioneta Faro Chico from a strip near Veracruz carrying 180 kg of cocaine toward Houston by way of the Gulf highway and a transfer point in Tamaulipas. The contact attributed the load to Valenzuela, a logistics figure for Pacto del Faro Gris known to the crews as El Cometa Rojo, and stated that the flight plan was filed under the name of a guesthouse firm, Posada Arroyo Pardo.

Shipment VER-11-04 transited Highway 180 Gulf route on 2011-11-04. Pacto del Faro Gris controlled Highway 180 Gulf route from 2011-01-22 until 2014-02-14. Ignacio Treviño Salcido led Pacto del Faro Gris from 2011-01-22 until 2016-03-09. The contact stated that the aircraft landed at a strip beside the Gulf highway where the load was transferred to a truck for the run north. The contact characterized the highway as the pact's route and Treviño as the head of the pact who approved the use of aircraft.

Ofelia Valenzuela Escandón was a member of Pacto del Faro Gris from 2011-01-22 until 2027-01-01. The contact described Valenzuela as a member of the pact from its founding who had previously run trucks for one of the three original crews. The reporting office assesses the contact as reliable on aviation records and as having secondhand access to the load itself. The source reporting was received through the standard liaison channel for this agency. The reporting office notes that the guesthouse firm appears in other reporting on the pact's paperwork and will report on it separately.
